name: Hungry Dark
summary: Creates a patch of darkness that drains the life of those within.

stats.effect: A 20-foot-radius Sphere of drifting shadow appears centered on a point within range. A creature that starts its turn there makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 3d8 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much on a success. You regain Hit Points equal to half the total damage dealt this way each turn.
